stages.description: Compare implementation, specification, README, skills/API records, security note, fixture, and packed receipt.
Apply only truthfulness, completeness, security-clarity, or traceability deltas exposed by inspection.
Run the complete packed gate, verify runtime ledgers, recursively check receipt statuses, and prove fixture bytes/hash.
Persist the QA report, manifest, reflection, log, state, and delta-first convergence decision.

tool_invocations.purpose: Run the one assembled packed time-travel integration gate.
Verify built root/optional runtime ledgers and parse the retained receipt.
Prove TypeScript/Flutter fixture byte and SHA-256 identity.

validation_plan.validation_method: Require the scoped built core ledger verifier to pass with unchanged root and ./devtools runtime export counts.
Require fixture parity/packed statuses and every package, consumer, and scenario status to pass, with both source hashes equal to the receipt.
Inspect public/evidence content for explicit downstream exclusions.
